economic_hypothesis: In a causally known BULL state, a non-extended three-session demand impulse, immediate low-turnover inside day, and first completed breakout within five sessions represents temporary supply contraction followed by renewed price discovery. The same chart sequence should not be traded in BEAR or TRANSITION states.
entry: exact V5 next legal executable open strictly after completed breakout, maximum three market sessions
